Help with Gwansang, the saju and face reading app for iPhone. If your question is not answered here, write to us and we will help.

Contact us

Getting started

What do I need to use Gwansang?

An iPhone with iOS 16.4 or later. There is no account to create: enter your birth date, and your birth time if you know it, and your chart is cast on your phone. The app is in English.

I do not know my birth time. Can I still use it?

Yes. On the birth time screen, choose “I don’t know my birth time”. Your chart is then read from three pillars instead of four. The hour pillar stays locked, and the daily, weekly, monthly, and Year Ahead readings still work. You can add the time later in Settings, under Birth details.

How do I change my birth details?

Open Settings (the square tile at the top right of Home) and choose Birth details. Your chart and every reading are recast right away, on your phone.

Why does my chart differ from another app or website?

Saju does not count years from January 1 or months from the 1st. The year turns at the start of spring, in early February, and each month begins at a solar term, between about the 4th and the 8th. Gwansang places your birth against those moments, and reads the day and the hour from the clock time you enter. It does not ask for a birthplace and makes no true-solar-time correction, which some other tools do. Your birth time is taken as a time in the time zone your phone is set to, so if you were born in another time zone within about a day of one of these turning points, the year or month pillar can come out on the other side of it.

Readings

What is free, and what is paid?

  • Free: your chart and today’s reading, every day.
  • With the Gwansang Membership, a monthly subscription: the weekly and monthly readings.
  • The Year Ahead, a yearly subscription of its own: each year opens the twelve months ahead.
  • Bought one at a time: the face reading, one purchase for each photo.
  • Members pay a lower price for the Year Ahead and the face reading; neither is included in the membership.

There is no free trial. The app shows each price in your own currency before you buy.

Where is today’s reading?

On Home, tap the Today card to open the full reading. If you turn on Morning reading in Settings, a line from each day’s reading also arrives as a notification at 9:00 AM.

Why do the months and the year start on unusual dates?

They follow the solar terms of the traditional calendar. A month begins between about the 4th and the 8th of a calendar month and runs to the same days of the next; the app names it after the calendar month it mostly covers and shows its exact dates. Each year of the Year Ahead subscription covers twelve of these months, starting with the one the year begins in, so its first month may already be underway. The months it covers are shown before you subscribe, and the reading lists each month’s dates.

The morning reminder does not arrive

Turn on Morning reading in Settings and allow notifications for Gwansang when your iPhone asks. Reminders are set on your phone for the next seven mornings each time you open the app, so open it at least once a week. A Focus mode or a Scheduled Summary on your iPhone can also hold notifications back.

Are the readings predictions?

No. Gwansang offers readings in the tradition of Korean saju and face reading, for reflection, cultural interest, and entertainment. They are not medical, legal, financial, or psychological advice, and they do not predict events.

Face reading

How does the face reading work?

Add a clear, front-facing photo of your own face. The app finds your features on your phone. When you ask for the reading, it first tells you what will be sent and to whom, and no photo leaves your phone until you agree. After the purchase, AI services write your reading and draw an ink portrait from your photo, usually in about a minute. Both are saved on your phone.

One purchase is one reading of one photo. A new photo needs a new purchase, and replaces the earlier reading.

My photo could not be read

The face reading reads one face at a time, of someone 14 or older. Use a clear, front-facing photo of your own face, in good light, with your whole face visible. If a photo is refused, your purchase is kept: choose another photo and the reading starts without a new payment.

I paid, but the reading did not arrive

A purchase is used only when its reading is made. If the reading fails, the purchase is kept and the next try uses it. If the app was closed or lost its connection while the reading was being made, open the face reading again: the app picks up the reading made for your photo, or finishes waiting for it.

If the app ever asks you to pay again for a photo you have already paid for, do not buy again. Email us with your reading reference and the order number from your Apple receipt, and we will fix it.

The reading has no portrait

“Your portrait is on its way” means the portrait exists but has not reached your phone yet: open the reading again while you are connected and it is fetched. “Portrait unavailable” means the drawing could not be made for this reading, or was not fetched within 30 days, after which our copy is deleted; the written reading is complete. If the drawing could not be made, email us with your reading reference.

How many readings can I ask for in a day?

Up to five attempts a day on one phone, counting photos that were refused. The count covers the last 24 hours, so if you reach the limit, try again a day after your first attempt; your purchase is kept. On a very busy day the service as a whole can reach its own daily limit and the app shows the same message; your purchase is kept then too.

How do I report a reading?

At the bottom of a face reading, tap Report this reading and choose a reason. We review every report. You can also email us.

Who can use the face reading?

People aged 14 and over, and only with a photo of your own face.

Membership and purchases

How do I cancel the membership or the Year Ahead?

Both are subscriptions with Apple: the membership renews every month, the Year Ahead every year. In the app, Settings → Gwansang Membership or Settings → Year Ahead opens your Apple subscriptions. On your iPhone you can also go to Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Gwansang. Cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date. You keep what you paid for until the end of the period. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

How do I get a refund?

Purchases are made through Apple, and Apple decides refunds. Ask for one at https://reportaproblem.apple.com. We never receive your payment details and cannot refund a purchase ourselves.

How do I restore my purchases?

The membership and the Year Ahead: tap Restore at the bottom of the membership screen (in Settings, tap Free plan) or of the Year Ahead screen. Use the Apple Account you subscribed with.

A face reading is saved only on the phone it was made on. Moving to a new iPhone from a backup or with Quick Start normally brings it along; if you delete the app, it is removed with it and cannot be brought back. If something you bought is missing, email us with the order number from your Apple receipt and we will tell you what we can do.

Why is my price different from someone else’s?

Prices are set for each country in its own currency, and local taxes can apply. The app always shows the price that applies to you before you buy. Members see a lower price for the face reading and the Year Ahead reading.

Your data

What leaves my phone?

Your birth details, your chart, and your daily, weekly, monthly, and Year Ahead readings are worked out on your phone and are never sent to us.

Of your own data, only the face reading is sent anywhere, and only after you agree: your photo and a few proportions of your face, with a random identifier. They go to our backend (Supabase, USA), which passes the photo to Replicate (USA); Replicate has Anthropic’s Claude write the reading and OpenAI’s image model draw the portrait. We do not store your photo; these AI providers may keep request data for up to 30 days. Purchases are paid through Apple, and each time the app opens it checks your membership and purchases with RevenueCat under an anonymous identifier. The app has no ads, and we run no analytics of our own.

The Privacy Policy has the full detail.

How do I delete my face reading and photo?

Settings → Delete face reading removes the reading, the portrait, and any reports from our server, and the photo and portrait from your phone. It also withdraws your permission, so the app asks again before sending any photo. Settings → Start over does the same and also clears your chart and settings. Your membership stays, because it belongs to your Apple Account.

Our server’s copy of a reading is deleted on its own 30 days after it was made. To have it removed sooner, use Delete face reading before you remove the app.

How do I ask about my data?

Most requests you can carry out in the app, as described above. For anything else, write to the address at the top of this page. We answer within 30 days.
